summary: Fox Corporation filed this 8-K (Item 8.01) on October 6, 2026, updating its pending acquisition of Roku, Inc. under a June 14, 2026 merger agreement using a two-step merger structure. Fox filed an S-4 on August 7, 2026, declared effective September 1, 2026, and a joint proxy/prospectus issued for October 14, 2026 special meetings. A putative Delaware class action, Thompson v. Fox, filed August 28, 2026, seeks to enjoin the Fox special meeting absent curative disclosure. Terms and premium were not restated in this excerpt; watch for supplemental disclosures and any postponement of the votes.
